report.name: Built-in
report.description: Default CATIA Magic Web 3.0 report data

variable.name: HomeImage
variable.description: Home page image. Empty: built-in overview page. Diagram name: open that diagram on the home page. mdel://elementID: image of that element. file://imagePath: copy an image file. http(s)://URL: link to a web image.

variable.name: UseContextMenu
variable.description: Show a context menu when right-clicking an element on a diagram

variable.name: ExportLinkedFile
variable.description: Copy attached files into the report and link them

variable.name: ShowAppearsInPage
variable.description: Show the diagrams each element appears in

variable.name: DisplayTreeElementId
variable.description: Show the element ID in the containment tree

variable.name: ShowAppliedStereotypes
variable.description: Show applied stereotypes in the containment tree

variable.name: SVGDiagramResizable
variable.description: Fit diagrams to the window when they open (users can still zoom)

variable.name: DiagramHotspots
variable.description: Make shapes on diagrams clickable (uses shape bounds from the model)

variable.name: IncludeAllProperties
variable.description: Include the full Specification property list for every element. Turn off to shrink output for very large models.

variable.name: DataFiles
variable.description: Write model data as separate data/*.js files that load progressively (recommended). Set false to put everything inside index.html (only for small models).

variable.name: DiagramPreviews
variable.description: Show diagram thumbnails on the home page by default (users can switch them on or off). Off keeps the home page fast for large models.

variable.name: SkipElementContext
variable.description: Must stay false: the template iterates $elements and $Diagram
